title: M2 mutation testing gate (ADR-006 milestone requirement)
description:
Run mutation testing before closing M2 epic. Required by ADR-006.

Python (new modules): uv run mutmut run on alcanzai_ingestion/arxiv_source.py, alcanzai_understanding/grobid_enricher.py, alcanzai_understanding/citation_enricher.py, alcanzai_understanding/coordinator.py.

Rust (new code): cargo mutants --in-place on ingest-job subcommand logic in alcanzai-core/src/bin/alcanzai.rs.

Pass criteria (per ADR-006):
- Core modules: zero surviving mutants without documented skip annotation.
- Surviving mutants in thin CLI glue (argparse wiring, subprocess call) are advisory; annotate with reason if skipped.

Record in closing comment: attempted / killed / survived / skipped counts for both Python and Rust.
